task.description: Independently validate REQ-226's design against all 8 acceptance criteria, real function-signature accuracy, tenant-scoping, and implementation-readiness.

result.note: FAIL on check 2 (no implementation code) -- immediate, complete failure per WF-02's no-partial-credit rule; all other checks passed independent verification. PRIMARY DEFECT: lib/letflow/design/req226-entity-definitions-persistence-crud.md:218-232 contains a literal, directly copy-pasteable Ecto.Schema DSL block -- `@primary_key {:id, :binary_id, autogenerate: true}` followed by `schema "entity_definitions" do ... field :tenant_id, :binary_id ... timestamps(updated_at: false) end`. This is not a '@type/@spec declaration, a column table, or plain-English rule description' as the doc's own preamble (lines 9-13) and REQ-225's own precedent both require ('no literal Ecto schema field lists' is REQ-225's own explicit prohibition, cited by this same author lineage) -- it is a real, executable `schema/2` macro block that an implementer could paste verbatim into lib/letflow/entities/entity_definition.ex and have it compile as-is. This is the same defect class (literal Elixir/DSL code embedded in a design doc) that caused REQ-157's two prior rework cycles (commits 3680243, 290c6b2) on this exact branch's sibling work -- the design doc's self-declared 'no implementation code' guarantee is false as written. Per WF-02's hard-gate rule this single failure fails the whole design regardless of the following points, all independently verified as sound: (1) all 8 ACs are covered with correct section pointers, traceability table (§7) matches doc content; (3) Letflow.Repository.create/2's real signature (lib/letflow/repository.ex:118-124) confirmed to require content_type/content/artifact_kind/artifact_name/created_by via Map.fetch!, matching the design's call-site assumptions exactly, including that `content` must be a raw JSON binary (Canonicaliser.canonicalize_content/2 guards on is_binary) -- design correctly calls Jason.encode!(attrs.definition) rather than passing the raw map; (4) Letflow.Repository.Activation.resolve/3 (activation.ex:156-177) and activate_group/5 (activation.ex:249-262, true arity 5 with opts \\ []) both confirmed keyed purely on (artifact_kind, artifact_name, prefix) with no exhaustive-atom branching -- :entity genuinely flows through with no new mechanism, confirming AC6; (5) list_versions/4's cursor contract (repository.ex:306-358) confirmed and design's list_definitions/2 adaptation (map-based filters instead of positional args, since entity_definitions is a dedicated single table needing no artifact_kind/artifact_name discriminator) is a reasoned, not superficial, adaptation -- same seek-predicate/page_size/cursor-prefix-tag idiom; (6) the three-way module naming (Letflow.Entities.Definition [REQ-225 document type, unchanged] vs Letflow.Entities.EntityDefinition [new Ecto schema] vs Letflow.Entities.Definitions [new CRUD context, plural]) is unambiguous, each given a distinct file path and cross-referenced against the real Repository/Artifact/ArtifactVersion precedent; (7) both AC4 dedup scenarios re-traced against Repository.create/2's real upsert_content/next_version pipeline and are logically consistent, including the OQ-1 caveat about a redundant artifact_versions row being minted before the entity_definitions UNIQUE constraint fires; (8) the error taxonomy's 9 shapes are pairwise distinguishable (tagged by {:validation,_}/{:repository,_}/{:persistence,_}/:invalid_schema_name/:not_found/pagination-specific atoms) and every non-tagged propagated value (e.g. activate_group/5's own error set) is enumerated rather than left as opaque term(); artifact_kind.ex independently confirmed as a bare 7-atom list with no exhaustive-match dependents (artifact_kind.ex:1-28), matching the design's one-line-addition claim; tenant-scoped placement confirmed via tenant_provisioning.ex's real tenant_scoped_migrations/0 manifest (line 567-568) and 0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md's Decision B. REQUIRED FIX: replace the §3.2 fenced schema block with the same column-table format already used in §1.2, or a bare @type t() field-shape declaration with no schema/field/timestamps macro calls -- the field list, types, and Ecto.Enum values can be fully conveyed without emitting compilable schema DSL. Route back to CODE-DESIGNER.
